simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דּוּמָה (H1745) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: דּוּמָה (dûwmâh) means silence ; figuratively, death First listed occurrence: Ps 94 17.

definitions.full: H1745. dumah I. דּוּמָה noun feminine silence ; — ׳ד = שְׁאוֺל Psa 94:17 , ד ׳יֹרְדֵי 115:17 ; also Isa 21:11 דּוּמָה מַשָּׂא oracle of silence , i.e. of concealment, hidden meaning, according to Ew Di, but see II. ׳ד , 3
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to be dumb (compare 1820 );
